title: Terrain Routing: A Reproducible Computational Study
model_boundary: Static isotropic travel cost in seconds per horizontal metre with separate impassable barriers; elevation-driven costs are illustrative, not calibrated travel dynamics.
timing_scope: End-to-end native wall time includes initialization and preprocessing; the subprocess hard limit also includes scenario generation and serialization.
interpretation: Fast marching is a grid-based reference. Differences are signed differences from the finest available reference, not optimality gaps. Grid disconnection is not a proof of continuous disconnection.
